title: Two wheeled treat to explore Seville
text: A relaxed and informative ride around Seville with a great guide. Great to stop for a drink on the way round to get to know the other cyclists 👏👏.. A really lovely way to start my holiday in Seville
author: 885rorym

title: Excellent tour with Daniel
text: Daniel was such a wonderful and informative tour guide on bikes.  He safety led us along bike paths, beautiful gardens and beautiful buildings ending at the Seville Catherdral and the Alcázar.  He provided so many interesting historical facts in a way you could take in and understand.  We took a break to have a cold drink and washrooms.  Even stopped in the park to feed the ducks!  I felt very safe on this tour.  He took time at the end and provided a map and recommendations and answered any questions we had.  I would definitely recommend this tour.  Great way to see the city!
author: Donna_B

title: Historic Seville Cycle Tour
text:
We had booked the sunst tour but because our train was late we moved to the 10.00am morning tour, which was actually much better to avoid the 35 - 37 degree heat of the early evening. The operator was very easy to communicate with (through Tripadvisor) and very cooperative about changing the time at relatively short notice. 

The Tour itself was very informative and the guide Marta provides a very good service and came across well. Marta was also very helpful about what else to do and where to go in Seville.
author: nickr486

title: Seville by bike
text: This was an excellent tour. Ivan was extremely knowledgeable and the perfect guide. We saw parts of Seville that we never would have seen on foot. We HIGHLY recommend this tour!
author: Q5887RZamyr

title: Relaxing, humorous, and memorable tour by local expert guide
text: The tour was excellent and Daniel was a fantastic guide. We got a lot of astonishing views, cool trivia and interesting history, brought in a crisp, humorous, and enganging way. Daniel ensured it was a relaxing yet memorable tour, and gave us recommendations that did not disappoint.
author: Nico-on-travels

title: the first bike tour of my life
text: Our guide was a student pursuing a Master’s degree in history. The tour was well balanced; you get just the right amount of information while covering a comfortable distance around the city. Seville is flat and full of bike lanes, which made it quite easy to get around. This was actually the first bike tour of my life, and it turned out to be a good experience!
author: benevolenskaya

title: Great sunset cycle ride with Daniel
text: Daniel was a great guide on our sunset cycle tour of Seville.  Not only knowledgeable, speaks several languages, he is very entertaining.  Would definitely recommend this tour with Daniel.
author: Carol_W

title: Sevilla by bike
text: Great way to see the city with an expert. Ivan have us a lot of information and great recomendaciones at the end of the tour
author: D1716NTcharlotten

title: Great experience with See By Bike in Seville! 🚲
text:
Great experience with See By Bike in Seville! 🚲
We took a 3 hour walk at the end of the day, a real happiness to discover the city differently. Daniel, our guide, was on top: passionate, funny and very pro! The excursion was in English, but he also speaks French as a chef 👏
Between historical anecdotes, humor and good humor, time has passed too quickly.
The city is perfectly suited to cycling with many dedicated lanes — a real pleasure to ride in Seville!
Recommended without hesitation! ⭐️⭐️‐️‐️‐️
author: lateamdechoc
